title: POOFer
description: This mod lets you spoof coordinates, targeted blocks, and other in-game information, enabling the use of the F3 menu without revealing your real coordinates or any identifiable data while streaming.
body:
This mod provides a comprehensive system for spoofing client‑side debug information, including player coordinates, targeted block data, biome details, and other F3 menu outputs. Its purpose is to allow streamers and content creators to use Minecraft’s debug screen without exposing sensitive or identifying information that could compromise their privacy or in‑game location.

By intercepting and replacing values before they are displayed, the mod ensures that all shown coordinates and related metrics are fully obfuscated while preserving the normal functionality and appearance of the F3 interface. This allows users to monitor performance, debug gameplay issues, and access technical data safely during livestreams or recorded sessions.

The system is configurable, lightweight, and designed to integrate cleanly with existing client environments with minimal impact on gameplay.
